SHRI MATA VAISHNO DEVI UNIVERSITY
Kakryal, Katra – 182320 (J&K)
(A State University recognised by UGC u/s 2(f) & 12(B) and ranked 101st among Engineering Institutions, 16th in
Architecture; top 125 Business Schools and among top 150 Universities in the NIRF 2022 ranking of MoE, GoI.)
Walk in Interview for Recruitment of Research Associate, Intern Programmer, Office Assistant and Office Helper
Applications are invited for the position of Research Associate, Intern Programmer, Office Assistant and Office Helper
under the research project titled, “Setting up of High-end computing AI and Deep Learning Lab at SMVDU”, funded by
HED, JKUT, purely on adhoc, temporary & contractual basis for an initial period upto March 2023 which may be extended
further on availability of funds;
